description: Validate the XML structure against the loaded DTD from the root element or from a chosen or selected element (Structure pane menu > Validate from Root Element / Validate from Selected Element), and list the errors (View List of Errors)

from.description: Validate from this element (default: the root). An XML element: its id (from list_xml_structure), its path of child indexes from the root element ([] is the root), the first element an XPath expression matches, or selection: true for the element selected in the Structure pane (or the selected tagged item). Give exactly one

path.description: Child indexes from the root, e.g. [0, 2] is the third child of the root's first child

selection.description: Use the element selected in the Structure pane

xpath.description: XPath expression evaluated from the root element, e.g. //article[@id="a1"]

name: validate_xml_structure
title: Validate XML Structure
